title: 2012 · 英语一 · Text 1
description: 这篇优先补“文章骨架词”：peer pressure、social cure、作者态度词和第22/23/25题错题词。先认骨架，再刷完整词卡。

cards.form: 原文：when we hear the words peer pressure

book.definition:
n. 同龄人，同辈；(英国的) 贵族
vi. 端详，费力地看

n. 压力；挤压；液压，气压
vt. 对…施压，逼迫

cards.quote: That whispered message, half invitation and half forcing, is what most of us think of when we hear the words peer pressure.
cards.translation: 那种低声说出、半是邀请半是强迫的话，就是我们大多数人在听到“同伴压力”一词时所想到的情景。
cards.note: 全文第一核心概念。先分清：作者承认 peer pressure 本身很强，但怀疑专家能否人为操控它。
cards.match: 两个词表词组成固定表达
cards.readingSource: 2012年考研英语一 · Text 1 · 试卷第3—4页

cards.form: 原文：what she calls the social cure

book.definition:
vt. 治愈，治好；解决；矫正
n. 药物，疗法；治疗；对策，措施

cards.quote: But in her new book Join the Club, Tina Rosenberg contends that peer pressure can also be a positive force through what she calls the social cure, in which organizations and officials use the power of group dynamics to help individuals improve their lives and possibly the world.
cards.meaning: “社会疗法”：利用群体影响改善行为
cards.translation: 但蒂娜·罗森伯格在新书《加入俱乐部》中主张，同伴压力也能通过她所谓的“社会疗法”成为积极力量：组织和官员利用群体互动的力量帮助个人改善生活，甚至可能改善世界。
cards.note: 全文第二核心概念。争议不是 peer pressure 有没有力量，而是这种人为设计的 social cure 是否长期有效。
cards.match: 语境概念；关联词条 cure

cards.quote: Far less certain, however, is how successfully experts and bureaucrats can select our peer groups and steer their activities in virtuous directions.
